questions.label: Where will the server run?
questions.help: Local stdio for Claude Desktop/Code, or an HTTP server for Docker/systemd.

questions.label: Bind host
questions.help: Interface the HTTP server binds to.

questions.label: Port
questions.help: TCP port for the HTTP server.

questions.label: Public base URL
questions.help: Public base URL of the deployed server, e.g. `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.

questions.label: Bearer token
questions.help: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.

questions.label: OIDC discovery URL
questions.help: OIDC discovery document URL, e.g. `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

questions.label: OIDC client ID
questions.help: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.

questions.label: OIDC client secret
questions.help: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.

questions.label: OIDC audience
questions.help: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.

questions.label: OIDC required scopes (CSV)
questions.help: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.

questions.label: OIDC JWT signing key
questions.help: Optional signing key for issued JWTs. When unset it is derived from the client secret; set explicitly to keep tokens valid across a secret rotation. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32.

questions.label: Verify access token (not id token)
questions.help: Validate the access token instead of the id token.

questions.label: KV store URL (HTTP session persistence)
questions.help: Persistent-state backend URL: memory://, file:///path, redis://, dynamodb://, or mongodb://. Defaults to file:///data/state when unset.

questions.label: Event store URL (HTTP resumability)
questions.help: Legacy state-backend override, honoured by `build_event_store` and `build_kv_store` only when `kv_store_url` is unset — it then backs every namespace, not just HTTP resumability. Prefer `kv_store_url` for new deployments.

questions.label: MCP Apps domain
questions.help: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.

questions.label: Bearer tokens file (TOML)
questions.help: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.

questions.label: Bearer default subject
questions.help: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.

questions.label: Server Name
questions.help: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

questions.label: Instructions
questions.help: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.

questions.label: HTTP endpoint path
questions.help: Mount path for the MCP endpoint.

questions.label: Log level
questions.help: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

questions.label: Rich logging
questions.help: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

questions.label: Ollama Host
questions.help: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.

questions.label: Openai Api Key
questions.help: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

questions.label: Build Timeout S
questions.help: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.

questions.label: Drain Timeout S
questions.help: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.

questions.label: Source Dir
questions.help: Path to the markdown vault directory. Required — the server refuses to start without it. Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

questions.label: Read Only
questions.help: Set to false to enable write tools (write, edit, delete, rename).

questions.label: Disable Apps Ui
questions.help: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.

questions.label: Index Path
questions.help: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.

questions.label: State Path
questions.help: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to {SOURCE_DIR}/.markdown_vault_mcp/state.json.

questions.label: Embeddings Path
questions.help: Path to the numpy embeddings file; required to enable semantic search.

questions.label: Indexed Fields
questions.help: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.

questions.label: Required Fields
questions.help: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.

questions.label: Exclude
questions.help: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

questions.label: Title Field
questions.help: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.

questions.label: Searchable Fields
questions.help: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.

questions.label: Templates Folder
questions.help: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).

questions.label: Prompts Folder
questions.help: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.

questions.label: Conventions File
questions.help: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.

questions.label: Okf Mode
questions.help: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.

questions.label: Okf Write
questions.help: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.

questions.label: Attachment Extensions
questions.help: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions without the dot (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist.

questions.label: Max Attachment Size Mb
questions.help: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.

questions.label: Max Note Read Bytes
questions.help: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.

questions.label: Chunks Per File
questions.help: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.

questions.label: Snippet Words
questions.help: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.

questions.label: Length Downweight Alpha
questions.help: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).

questions.label: Max Chunk Words
questions.help: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.

questions.label: Max Chunk Chars
questions.help: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.

questions.label: Chunk Overlap Words
questions.help: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.

questions.label: Folder Weights
questions.help: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).

questions.label: Fts Weights
questions.help: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.

questions.label: Embedding Provider
questions.help: Embedding provider: openai, ollama, or fastembed. Unset auto-detects from the environment.

questions.label: Ollama Model
questions.help: Ollama embedding model name.

questions.label: Ollama Cpu Only
questions.help: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.

questions.label: Openai Base Url
questions.help: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.

questions.label: Openai Embedding Model
questions.help: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.

questions.label: Fastembed Model
questions.help: FastEmbed model name.

questions.label: Fastembed Cache Dir
questions.help: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).

questions.label: Embed Context
questions.help: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.

questions.label: Git Token
questions.help: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

questions.label: Git Repo Url
questions.help: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

questions.label: Git Username
questions.help: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).

questions.label: Git Pull Interval S
questions.help: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.

questions.label: Git Push Delay S
questions.help: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.

questions.label: Git Commit Name
questions.help: Git committer name for auto-commits; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.

questions.label: Git Commit Email
questions.help: Git committer email for auto-commits.

questions.label: Git Commit Name Claim
questions.help: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name); overrides GIT_COMMIT_NAME per request when an OIDC token is present.

questions.label: Git Commit Email Claim
questions.help: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email); overrides GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL per request when an OIDC token is present.

questions.label: Git Lfs
questions.help: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.

questions.label: File Watcher
questions.help: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull or the webhook is active. Requires the file-watcher extra.

questions.label: File Watcher Debounce S
questions.help: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.

questions.label: File Watcher Root Floor
questions.help: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.

questions.label: Github Webhook Secret
questions.help: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.

questions.label: Summarize Provider
questions.help: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.

questions.label: Summarize Openai Api Key
questions.help: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

questions.label: Summarize Openai Base Url
questions.help: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.

questions.label: Summarize Openai Model
questions.help: Chat model id used for summaries.

questions.label: Summarize Max Tokens
questions.help: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.

questions.label: Summarize Max Notes
questions.help: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).

questions.label: Summarize Max Input Chars
questions.help: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.

questions.label: Summarize Timeout
questions.help: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.

questions.label: Summarize Inline Timeout
questions.help: Soft deadline in seconds before a still-running summarize call is promoted to a background job retrievable via get_summary. Must be <= SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT.

questions.label: Transfer Ttl Default S
questions.help: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

questions.label: Transfer Ttl Max S
questions.help: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

questions.label: Transfer Grace Ttl S
questions.help: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

questions.label: Transfer Lease S
questions.help: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

questions.label: Transfer Max Upload Bytes
questions.help: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

guards.message: OIDC needs BASE_URL set. Leaving OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY unset derives the key from the client secret, so rotating that secret invalidates every issued token.
